verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Adyen syncing merchant product catalogs to third-party AI platforms such as OpenAI and Meta through its Feed API. It also shows tokenized ACP/UCP checkout flows. Neither is an Adyen-published directory or discovery index where agents find payable services and APIs. Catalog syndication into other platforms' surfaces is an adjacent feature, and llms.txt only indexes documentation, so no evidence shows the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can discover payable services and APIs through a published directory or discovery index
